search_window.basis: One-hour schedule-derived recall window through execution completion. The immediately preceding Food Line heartbeat completion was not independently resolved this run; no claim of exhaustive hourly coverage.

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; production nationwide Food Line collector remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches completed, recency 2 days, focused on only/sole/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-canceled emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reduction, and official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

Search results contained no verifiable U.S. qualifying report demonstrably new within the one-hour observation window. Older events and unrelated donation drives, routine promotions, guides, and non-U.S. stories were excluded.

Examples of excluded stale stories: Sept. 11, 2026 Spencer NY only-grocery fire; Oct. 7, 2026 Prodisee Pantry weather cancellation; earlier food-bank closures and 2025 federal SNAP interruption coverage.
The October 24 Dallas Project 75216 and Clearwater BBC Food Pantry closure reports referenced in prior Food Line heartbeats were not reintroduced as new signals.
Search indexing may miss fresh provider social-media notices, especially overnight local time; absence of a matching result is not evidence of nationwide absence.
No source-fetch or web-search tool errors during this bounded search. No approval, publication, production-collector, or schedule changes.
